shortlist.label: Facial nerve schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gradual-onset unilateral facial weakness with a mass in the ear canal and imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen

shortlist.label: Chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Microscopic examination showing pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei and a myxochondroid matrix, consistent with cartilaginous tumor

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a nonpulsatile mass in the inferior ear canal and imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid

shortlist.label: Facial nerve hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen and expansion of the fallopian canal

shortlist.label: Geniculate ganglion hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Location of the lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen, consistent with a geniculate ganglion tumor

raw.rationale: The patient's 2-year history of gradual-onset right facial weakness, nonpulsatile mass in the inferior ear canal, and imaging findings of an irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen are consistent with a diagnosis of Facial Nerve Schwannoma. The expansion of the fallopian canal and stylomastoid foramen on CT also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: While the pathology report mentions a 'cartilage' specimen, the clinical and imaging findings are more consistent with a Facial Nerve Schwannoma, and the microscopic examination shows features more typical of a schwannoma, such as pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei staining positive for S100.
